title: API Wrapper to the FRED and ALFRED Federal Reserve Economic Data API
text: FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data) standard free source US macro series — GDP, unemployment, money supply, financial-conditions indices, dollar, Treasury yields, hundreds thousands . package returns series tidy data.tables, synchronously asynchronously, typed columns typed errors. reason exist alongside excellent CRAN alternatives one discipline leave : vintages first-class, typed surface.

title: API Wrapper to the FRED and ALFRED Federal Reserve Economic Data API
text: FRED serves latest revised value every observation. macro series revised long first release — money supply, unemployment, jobless claims restate history seasonal factors population controls re-estimated; financial-conditions index revises entire history every week. history FRED shows today history anyone actually past: embeds numbers exist . Backtesting strategy look-ahead construction — model silently “knows” revisions yet happened. ALFRED (ArchivaL FRED) fix. serves every value known point time. package makes -known-surface headline method (get_series_vintages()), typed tested, point--time backtest can honest.

title: API Wrapper to the FRED and ALFRED Federal Reserve Economic Data API
text: data.table everywhere, list columns. Every method returns one flat data.table; observation value typed nullable (FRED serves . missing observation, becomes NA, never 0), structural columns (ids, dates, real-time-window bounds) strict. Sync async. Every request-making method works modes. async = TRUE returns [promise][promises::promise]; otherwise table returned directly. single sync/async branch point (inherited connectcore), threaded even vintage pager. Vintage-first. get_series() exposes real-time window directly (latest values simply today’s window); get_series_vintages() returns whole -known-matrix, offset-paged ~900,000-row history streams back safely. Typed errors. Every failure classed condition (fred_api_error, fred_validation_error) carrying structured fields — branch type, never grep message. API key redacted every stored URL.

title: API Wrapper to the FRED and ALFRED Federal Reserve Economic Data API
text: Set async = TRUE consume promise coro::async / await, driving event loop later:
code: box::use(coro, later)  client_async <- FredSeries$new(async = TRUE)  main <- coro::async(function() {     unrate <- await(client_async$get_series("UNRATE"))     nfci <- await(client_async$get_series_vintages("NFCI"))     print(list(unrate = unrate, nfci = nfci)) })  main() while (!later::loop_empty()) later::run_now()

what: FredSeries: the FRED / ALFRED economic-data client — FredSeries
title: FredSeries: the FRED / ALFRED economic-data client — FredSeries
text: Retrieves St. Louis Fed economic data: series observations real-time window (get_series), ALFRED -known-vintage history (get_series_vintages), series metadata (get_series_info), full-text search (search_series), release calendar (get_releases / get_release_dates). Every method returns tidy data.table::data.table.

title: FredSeries: the FRED / ALFRED economic-data client — FredSeries
text: Inherits transport plumbing (single sync/async request funnel, retry, throttle) connectcore::RestClient customises two seams specific FRED: .sign() — FRED authentication single query-parameter api_key, appends &api_key=<FRED_API_KEY>&file_type=json every request (HMAC JWT). .parse_envelope() — FRED answers every failure real non-2xx HTTP status JSON {error_code, error_message} body, raises typed fred_conditions error.

what: Vintages vs latest — the revision trap
title: FredSeries: the FRED / ALFRED economic-data client — FredSeries
text: FRED ALFRED host, split realtime_start / realtime_end window output_type. latest value observation simply value today's real-time window; separate endpoint code path. get_series() exposes window directly: omit latest values, pass past realtime_start see known . get_series_vintages() returns whole -known-matrix (every value every observation stood real-time window) — honest surface point--time backtest. See get_series_vintages() matters.

title: FredSeries: the FRED / ALFRED economic-data client — FredSeries
text: async argument selects execution mode every method: async = FALSE (default): methods return data.table::data.table. async = TRUE: methods return promises::promise resolves data.table. mode stored private$.is_async threaded every method's connectcore::then_or_now() tail (vintage pager); nothing hardcodes . Consume promises coro::async() await(); drive loop script (!later::loop_empty()) later::run_now().

title: Typed fred conditions — fred_conditions
text: Transport failures nest specific -> general fred_api_error_<status> -> fred_api_error -> connectcore_api_error_<status> -> connectcore_api_error -> connectcore_error, carrying fields status (HTTP status), error_code (FRED's error code response body), url, body_snippet. Raised non-2xx HTTP status, including missing/invalid-key case (FRED answers plain HTTP 400 whose JSON body names key problem; unlike APIs HTML redirect disentangle). Validation failures nest fred_validation_error -> fred_error (domain root). Raised malformed argument (empty series_id, realtime_end realtime_start, unknown search_type) request made. url stored query-string credentials redacted (via connectcore::scrub_url(), whose sensitive-parameter set matches key api_key), logging e$url never leaks FRED key.

title: fred 0.1.0
text: Initial release: St. Louis Fed’s FRED ALFRED economic data fleet’s connector idiom, built vintage-first. plain English: package fetches official US economic statistics — GDP, unemployment, money supply, financial-conditions indices, dollar, Treasury yields — one typed, tested interface works synchronously asynchronously. Unlike general-purpose alternatives, treats vintages (number known point past) first-class surface, backtest can use numbers trader actually rather today’s revised history — difference honest backtest look-ahead illusion. FredSeries: client, shared connectcore transport, sync + async threaded constructor. Methods: get_series() (observations real-time window — latest values simply today’s window, never separate code path); get_series_vintages() (headline — ALFRED output_type=1 -known-long form); get_series_info() (metadata, including revision-cadence notes); search_series(); get_releases(); get_release_dates(). Vintage-first, point--time honest. get_series_vintages() returns one row per (observation date, real-time window), carrying value current window; realtime_end "9999-12-31" means still current. whole-history matrix heavily-revised series exceeds FRED’s 100,000-row response cap, pulled disjoint offset pages stitch back un-paged whole seam clip, skip, duplicate — offset-pager logic proven live data-scraper’s src/fred collector (NFCI’s 906,899 rows reassemble byte-identical) ported typed form, seam-stitching proof unit test. Faithful typed shapes (FredObservations, FredVintages, FredSeriesInfo, FredReleases, FredReleaseDates) every column documented typed bullets — observation value numeric | NA FRED serves . missing observation (becomes NA, never 0); observation date real-time-window bounds structural strict. Typed conditions birth: fred_api_error layered front connectcore transport chain (carrying status, FRED’s body error_code, key-redacted url, body_snippet); fred_validation_error fred_error domain root. test proves API key redacted every stored URL. Grounded live API’s error envelope (real non-2xx status plus JSON {error_code, error_message} body — missing/invalid key plain HTTP 400, HTML redirect disentangle) fully-synthetic mock fixtures offline. Live tests (get_series, vintages, metadata, search, releases) gate FRED_LIVE_TESTS working key; every FRED endpoint needs key, keyless surface.
